theme.title: NBA Mix 36
theme.subtitle: Five moments from across NBA history
theme.recap: Five NBA stories, five different numbers: a quick tour of stars, teams, records and surprises.

questions.prompt: In Game 5 of the 2016 Finals, LeBron James and Kyrie Irving each scored how many points?
questions.context: 2016 NBA Finals · Game 5 · at Golden State
questions.note: 41 apiece, the first teammates to both reach 40 in a Finals game.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: James and Irving each scored 41 points to become the first teammates in Finals history to score 40 or more

funFacts.text: Draymond Green missed the game through suspension after a flagrant foul against LeBron.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Green was suspended for Game 5

funFacts.text: Green watched the contest from a luxury box in the Oakland Athletics' stadium.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Green watched the game from a luxury box in the nearby Oakland Alameda Coliseum

funFacts.text: Cleveland was facing elimination after Golden State had taken three of the first four games.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Warriors won three of the first four games and led 3–1

questions.prompt: Lew Alcindor led the NBA in scoring in 1970–71. What was his average?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: In only his second professional season, Lew Alcindor led the league in scoring at 31.7 ppg

funFacts.text: Alcindor won both the league MVP and Finals MVP awards during Milwaukee's title season.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Lew Alcindor won MVP and Finals MVP honors

funFacts.text: Milwaukee made its first Finals appearance in only its third year as a franchise.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Bucks made their way into the Finals for the first time in NBA history in just their third year

funFacts.text: Bob Dandridge provided another major scoring option with 18.4 points a game.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Bob Dandridge (18.4 ppg)

questions.prompt: In the first half of Game 3 of the 2014 Finals, what percentage of their shots did the Spurs make?
questions.note: 75.8%, a Finals record for a half.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: a Finals-record 75.8% shooting effort from the team during the first half

funFacts.text: Popovich inserted Boris Diaw into the starting five, opening up extra passing lanes against Miami.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: San Antonio's insertion of Boris Diaw into the starting lineup created more ball movement

funFacts.text: Kawhi Leonard began the game with a perfect string of made shots and set a new personal scoring high.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Leonard, limited to only 18 points in the first two games, made his first six shots

funFacts.text: Miami hadn't lost at home in that postseason before San Antonio's sudden offensive explosion.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Heat, who had been 8–0 at home in the playoffs

questions.prompt: How many fans attended the first NBA All-Star Game in 1951?
questions.note: 10,094, when the average crowd was about 3,500.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: drawing an attendance of 10,094, much higher than that season's average attendance of 3,500.

funFacts.text: The first All-Star Game came out of a public-relations push following a college basketball point-shaving scandal.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the basketball world had just been rocked by the college basketball point-shaving scandal

funFacts.text: Celtics owner Walter Brown offered to host the event and cover any losses himself.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Brown remained confident that it would be a success. He even offered to host the game

funFacts.text: The original All-Stars were chosen by sportswriters who were not allowed to vote for players from their own cities.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: They were not allowed to select players from their own cities

questions.prompt: How many points did Seattle score in its decisive Game 5 loss to Denver?
questions.context: NBA playoffs · first-round upset · Seattle vs Denver
questions.note: 94 points in overtime as Denver completed a historic upset.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: losing Game 5 to the Nuggets at the Seattle Center Coliseum in overtime, 98–94

funFacts.text: Denver's roster featured Dikembe Mutombo and Mahmoud Abdul-Rauf.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: a team that featured defensive shot-blocker Dikembe Mutombo, Mahmoud Abdul-Rauf

funFacts.text: Seattle won the first two games at home before losing the next two on the road.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The SuperSonics won the first two games over the Nuggets at home

funFacts.text: The Nuggets became the first No. 8 seed to eliminate a top seed in NBA playoff history.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: it was the first time in NBA playoffs history that a #8 seed defeated a #1 seeded team
